title: Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis: Zero-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation and Non-Linear Decision Boundaries
description: This dataset and research package presents the complete experimental verification, source code, and interactive visualizers for Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis. By sampling 128x128 patches from the complex Mandelbrot set (z = z^2 + c) using 4-Quadrant Partitioning, synaptic weights (w1, w2, w3) and activation biases (b) are procedurally derived without persistent scalar storage. A functional decision unit is defined by only 24 bytes (three 64-bit coordinates), achieving >99.99999998% memory reduction compared to conventional static neural weight tensors. The repository includes Python verification scripts, high-resolution figures, standalone offline HTML/JS labs, and an extended Turkish academic summary.
notes: Includes full replication source code, interactive offline HTML5 labs, and bilingual (English/Turkish) documentation.
